title: DailyReport
description: Represents a daily work report created by a supervisor documenting cleaning activities, tasks, and materials used.

id.description: Unique identifier for the daily report.

date.description: The date of the report (ISO 8601 date string).

siteId.description: Reference to the Site where work was performed.

siteName.description: Denormalized site name for display purposes.

clientName.description: Denormalized client name for display purposes.

supervisorId.description: Reference to User (Supervisor) who created this report. Required for authorization.

workerIds.description: Array of User IDs (Workers) assigned to this report. Required for authorization.

workers.description: Array of worker details (denormalized for display).

startTime.description: The starting time of the cleaning session (ISO 8601 time or datetime string).

endTime.description: The ending time of the cleaning session (ISO 8601 time or datetime string).

tasks.description: List of task IDs completed during this session.

additionalTasks.description: List of additional task descriptions not in the standard task list.

materials.description: List of material IDs used during this session.

beforeImages.description: URLs of images taken before cleaning.

afterImages.description: URLs of images taken after cleaning.

clientSignature.description: URL or base64 representation of the client's signature approving the work.

supervisorSignature.description: URL or base64 representation of the supervisor's signature.

status.description: The current status of the daily report.

totalCost.description: The total cost of the cleaning session.

notes.description: Additional notes or comments about the work performed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the report was created (Firestore Timestamp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the report was last updated (Firestore Timestamp).
